methodologyNotes: Covers cordless (battery-powered) upright wet-dry floor washers that vacuum and wash sealed hard floors in a single pass using onboard clean- and dirty-water tanks. Excludes corded floor washers, robot mops/robot vacuums, cordless dry stick vacuums, and steam mops without suction. Price is typical US retail or MSRP in USD. suctionPa is rated suction in pascals (Pa); marketing air-watt (AW) figures are not counted, and this is null if suction is not published in Pa. runtimeMinutes is maximum cordless runtime on a full charge in the standard/ECO mode, in minutes. cleanTankMl is fresh-water tank capacity in milliliters; dirtyTankMl is waste-water tank capacity in milliliters. rollerType is an enum: single-roller or dual-roller. selfCleaning is a boolean: true if the dock runs a hot-water/hot-air brush self-clean and dry cycle. hotWaterWash is a boolean: true if the unit washes the floor with heated water rather than ambient water only. steamCleaning is a boolean: true if the unit emits steam for sanitizing. edgeCleaning is a boolean: true for zero-gap edge-to-edge roller coverage on at least one side. reclineAngleDeg is the maximum lay-flat recline angle from vertical, in degrees (180 = fully flat). chargeTimeHours is full recharge time in hours. weightKg is the main handle-assembly unit weight in kilograms, excluding the dock.
